_readme: Shop catalogue (Campaign Foundation T12/T13). Loaded by ShopCatalogueAsset; ShopCatalogue.BuiltIn() holds the same data as a fallback.
The Supply Counter (Level 1) and the 3D Menu SHOP open the same catalogue book over this one file and one wallet.
products: id (stable, saved in campaign.ownedUpgradeIds once bought), kind (item | upgrade | decor), section (supplies | office: the book's tabs, six cards each),
consumable (T14: bought again and again with a fresh request each time, never owned; the review voucher can be bought while fewer than two are carried),
itemId (item: inventory.json id), area + capacity (upgrade: Bag 7-13 / Hotbar 4-5; T30: every Bag tier is one slot larger, base 6), anchors (decor: display anchor ids, preferred first),
price (coins), title, tagline, effect (plain words), icon (HudIconArt picture),
requires ("", chapter:<id>, or pending:<feature> = not in this build; unmet = a teaser card that cannot be bought) with requiresLabel, after (a product that must be owned first).
Level 1 earns 160 coins. No paid answers, selling or loot boxes. Decor is installed in the office, never carried or sold, and changes no score.

counter: where the Supply Counter stands. entrance door paths (averaged) or fallback; candidates step toward `toward` by each distance and sideways by each offset (metres); the first clear spot on open ground wins. useFixed + fixedPosition [x,y,z] + fixedYaw pin an exact spot; flip turns it round.

anchors: office display spots. surface = a free spot on `target` under `parent`, on the `side` (right | left) seen from the desk seat, toward the far corner; wall = on the wall behind `target`, `above` metres over its top. A piece whose spot is taken moves to its next free anchor; with none free the purchase is refused before any coin moves.
anchors kind floor (T14): the first clear floor spot beside `target` on the seat's `side`, nearest the seat (no anchor uses it since the Desk Drawer unit was removed).
